patches_added.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_added.description: Keeps messages that were unsent in 1:1 and group chats on your device instead of destroying them, and shows the usual "unsent a message" notice directly below the message it kept. Doesn't apply to OpenChat.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Restores push notifications on re-signed builds when LINE is fully closed. Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches_modified.name: Bypass anti-tamper
patches_modified.description: Stubs TBank's native RASP executor calls and neutralizes tamper flag reporting.

patches_modified.name: Remove TBank ads
patches_modified.description: Removes TBank stories and promotional surfaces.
